A long-awaited reunion. A night where the words we shared in person linger warmly in my heart.
I took the Shinkansen to meet a friend I hadn't seen in a long time.
From the very first word, "It's been a while," time seemed to rewind in an instant.
We caught up on each other's lives, talked about the time that had passed, our future plans, and even aimless chatter; before I knew it, we had exchanged so many words.
The subtle changes in expression and the sound of laughter are things that just don't come across through a smartphone screen.
We listened intently to each other and shared the same time in the same space.
It was more luxurious than I had imagined, and a truly "precious time" that nothing else could replace.
